steps.note: Run `manni meta schemas` for the full built-in list.
Reference your own schema by path: `manni meta validate docs/ -s ./schemas/metadata.schema.json`.
Stack a type vocabulary with OKF: `manni meta validate docs/ -s diataxis:diataxis:1.0 -s google:okf:0.1`.
Point a document at its schema, step 3: validate path/to/document.md after adding `$schema:`.

scaffolding: docs/ with three pages typed as Diataxis forms (tutorial, how-to, reference), schemas/metadata.schema.json (the page's required-vs-recommended example), and path/to/document.md, the page's example document without `$schema:`. The page has the reader add `$schema: ./schemas/metadata.schema.json`, so a spec edits the file before the last validate.
